title: Lawyers Fined $5,000 After Using ChatGPT Fake Cases #shorts
description:
Lawyers cited fictitious legal cases generated by ChatGPT in a federal personal injury lawsuit. Judge P. Kevin Castel dismissed the case and fined the attorneys $5,000 for acting in bad faith. Source: Mata v. Avianca, Inc. (U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York).

Source: Wikipedia, Mata v. Avianca, Inc..
Photos credited on file. Narration is a synthetic voice.
